skill_name: What would you do if you had to make a presentation but were not prepared?
workflow: If I had to make a presentation but were not prepared, I would take a deep breath and try to remain calm. I would ask for permission to take some time to prepare, or try to buy some time by asking for questions from the audience or other presenters. After that, I would gather as much material as possible, review it quickly, and create an outline of my ideas. During the presentation, I would try to remain relaxed and be interactive.
